rows.en: Garyud: "...I see. In that case,
you should stay in this country for a while.
If it would not inconvenience you."
Thora: "But I am from Zigrim..."
Garyud: "Then let me ask you: Are you our enemy?
Or do you wish to become our enemy?"
Thora: "N-No. Nothing of the sort."
Garyud: "Then stay here without worrying.
I believe we have at least the strength to protect you."
Grad: "Thank you for your consideration."
Thora: "...Dear, is this all right?"
Grad: "It would be rude to refuse such a generous offer.
Besides, even if we returned to Zigrim now,
we would only cause trouble for General Growster."
Garyud: "Then it is decided."
Thora: "Thank you for having us."
Kasumi: "...Thank goodness."
Grad: "I must thank you as well.
Had you not stopped me back then,
I would not be here like this now."
Kasumi: "Oh, no... I'm the one who injured you."
Grad: "Hahahaha. This hardly even counts as an injury."
Thora: "You aren't so young anymore,
so don't get carried away."
Grad: "That's a bit harsh."
Kasumi: "Hehehehehe."
Maki: "Well now, pardon the interruption!"
Fain: "Oh, Maki! I hadn't seen you around.
Where have you been?"
Maki: "Just sorting through some information.
Say, would you like to know about the person behind Zigrim?"
Touya: "Person? You mean ≪Ze=Ode≫?"
Maki: "That's what I'm not sure about.
But the possibility of that person having been ≪Ze=Ode≫
is very high.
After all, I hear this person was providing technical assistance."
Bernst: "I see. As for ≪Ze=Ode≫'s intentions,
they remain unclear, so we cannot say for certain,
but direct intervention would certainly not be
the only way to act.
Those who possess power beyond their means
cannot help using it..."
Touya: "And that's what the Zigrim Army's Armored Mechs are now?"
Bernst: "Most likely."
Maki: "Information, part two. We've long heard rumors that Zigrim and Agarthia
were about to go to war, but the fighting has already started,
and apparently Zigrim has the upper hand."
Touya: "Huh? That's the first I've heard of it!"
Ymir: "Lady Ivel and His Highness probably kept it from us
out of consideration for our situation..."
Maki: "...And apparently, the Agarthian Army has now
pulled its battle lines back considerably. By the way, the Agarthian Army's
commander is Colonel Geel Jin Dial.
He's known as Marshal Revios's trusted right-hand man...
But I hardly need to tell you that."
Celica: "The colonel... He's certainly clever,
but I don't like him. He's obsessed with efficiency."
Fain: "Maki, what about my master?"
Maki: "It seems he hasn't gone to the front yet.
But he probably will soon, won't he?
You don't need to worry about Rest.
More importantly, I've saved the best information for last.
Mind you, it's still unconfirmed,
but apparently there are some suspicious movements in Agarthia's capital.
They're carefully camouflaged, but containers apparently holding disassembled Armored Mechs
are being brought in.
Maybe those terrorists, 'Dawn of an Era,'
are involved."
Celica: "You mean they're planning something in the capital?"
Maki: "Yes. They've been quiet lately, haven't they?
Apparently, they're planning a large-scale terrorist attack.
Well? Pretty amazing information, isn't it?"
Touya: "You're being awfully cooperative."
Maki: "W-Well, yes. I've reported all sorts of things based on my own assumptions,
and said I would expose you and all that.
I think I might have been looking at things with a biased eye.
So consider this a token of apology for everything.
But this is just for today.
Next time I'll charge a proper information fee, so be ready! ♥"
Ymir: "Maki, thank you."
Touya: "If something like that might happen in the capital,
shouldn't we warn them properly and head there ourselves?"
Ai: "I agree! If it comes to it, we could hover over the capital
on standby and suppress them as soon as they make a move.
That could work."
Arthur: "That is a little heavy-handed.
But we should be ready
to respond to the situation."
Kasumi: "U-Um... What about York?"
Clovis: "Right. If Zigrim's gone to war with Agarthia,
they might stop meddling here,
but we can't be completely sure we're safe, can we?"
Xiujian: "Yes. We cannot let our guard down."
Garyud: "You need not worry about that.
Happily, voices in support of our liberation movement
are rising throughout the land.
If things go well, we may be able to win public opinion to our side.
Even if we do not, knights who share our cause
have promised their help. The day of liberation is finally drawing near."
Touya: "I see... So we don't have to worry anymore?"
Garyud: "Yes. So do not concern yourselves with us.
Act as you see fit."
Ai: "I see... Just a little longer, then..."
Garyud: "Yes. From now on, we must work to stabilize the country.
To rebuild this land that Her Majesty sought to protect."
Ai: "Yes."
Garyud: "Thank you for all your help until now.
But we could not find a lead concerning ≪Ze=Ode≫,
and you ended up having to help with the fighting...
I am sorry."
Ymir: "No. We only did what was right.
Besides, it is not as if we learned nothing at all."
Clovis: "Then our next destination
is the capital."
Aurelie: "We'll have to stop those terrorists..."
Celea: "Oh, it seems your brother has gone out."
Bio: "So he couldn't do it after all..."
Celea: "But you look happy about it."
Bio: "Do I? I'm disappointed that such a promising business opportunity
has come to nothing."
Celea: "Hehehe... You're kind, aren't you?"
Bio: "Oh, come now..."
Celea: "Sooner or later, that girl would have regained her memory.
In the worst case, it would have happened while fighting them, like before,
and she would have left your brother.
Before that happened, you made him face that fact
and prepare himself to part with her of his own accord...
Though one wrong step could have made it a disaster."
Bio: "Hehehehe... Well, all's well that ends well.
We're each other's only blood relatives.
I couldn't simply stand by and watch my brother suffer."
Celea: "Those hardly sound like the words of Bio,
the ruthless merchant of death."
Bio: "Come now. It's not as if I'm always wearing
a mask."
Celea: "Oh? I thought the face you're showing now
was the mask."
Bio: "Hehehehe... Yes.
I don't know which is my real face anymore either.
Maybe there was never one to begin with..."
York Soldier: "R-Reporting, sir!
We have just detected an abnormal Prana signature.
The mech previously detected in the Holy Land...
This signature is identical to that one!"
Touya: "What!?"
York Soldier: "Bringing up the image!"
Touya: "Th-That's..."
Ai: "Rayode!"
Bernst: (...So it has come after all...)
Celica: "Touya! I told you, no!
The adjustments aren't finished yet!"
Touya: "The Rayblade's the only thing that can stand up to him!"
Mechanic A: "Chief! The anti-field units are operational
on only two mechs! The rest still can't be used!"
Touya: "Then that's all the more reason.
Whatever you say, I'm going out!"
Celica: "...Then I'm coming aboard."
Touya: "Huh?"
Celica: "Did you forget the Rayblade has two seats?
Besides, the support program isn't working properly.
So I'll take its place."
Touya: "...All right. I'm counting on you for support!"
Celica: "Right! Also, the Rayblade doesn't have a sword,
so use the Zeifon's!"
Touya: "Understood! Then it's time for the reborn Rayblade's
big unveiling! ...Let's go!!"
Reduce: "Lord Garyud, let us sortie as well!"
Garyud: "Yes. But you are to stay here.
And I want you to protect Ciel."
Reduce: "...What exactly do you mean by that?"
Garyud: "I will tell you when the time comes.
But for now, will you obey without asking?"
Reduce: "...Understood.
But in that case, I believe you would be more suited to the task, Lord Garyud."
Garyud: "Do you lack confidence?"
Reduce: "How unkind...
Still, if you are content with me, I will accept."
Garyud: "...Forgive me."
